title: A Ticket She Never Used
subtitle: 航空出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 航空出行（生活与学习·航空出行）
meta: 主题语境：航空出行（生活与学习·航空出行）　|　核心词汇：airline　|　正文 367 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 airline 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 my cousin joined an ① airline, which in our family was the same as leaving, and my grandmother said the word had four letters more than the road and was nine times less use. She kept the ② airline ticket he sent her in 1968, in a drawer, for thirty-one years, and it was for a flight she never took; an airline, she said, is a company that sells you a seat in a place you cannot see.

He was ③ an airline pilot by 1971, which my mother called the only job where you are trusted with nine hundred people and not with a key. The ④ airline he flew first, meaning the route and not the company, was nine hundred miles and took four hours, and he said the two uses had never once been the same word to him; an airline, he said, is a line on a map until you have flown it.

There was one ⑤ domestic airline in the country then, and my grandmother said a country with one airline is a country with one road in the sky. The ⑥ airline industry, which is the phrase he used in 1979, had four companies by then and nine kinds of ticket, and he said industry is what people say when a thing has stopped being a job; airlines, he said, are the only companies that apologise for the weather.

In 1984 the ⑦ airlines all lost money in the same year, and he said that was the first honest thing they had ever done together. Every ⑧ airline magazine in the house had the same four photographs, and my grandmother said an airline is the only company that sells the same picture nine times, and that the airline is never in the photograph.

The ⑨ airline I would name, if I named one, is the one that sent a ticket to a woman who never flew, and never answered the letter she wrote. An ⑩ airline, he told me in 1996, is only ever the distance between two people and the price of closing it; every airline, he said, is a promise about a Thursday, and the route he flew first was the only one he ever described twice.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: C. n. （常用复数 airlines）航空业；各家航空公司
D. （作定语）航空公司的；航线的
E. 固定搭配：an airline pilot / stewardess 航空公司飞行员／空乘
F. 固定搭配：airline ticket / booking 机票／订座
G. 固定搭配：domestic / international airline 国内／国际航空公司
H. 固定搭配：airline industry 航空业

items.q: joined an airline, which in our family
the airline ticket he sent her
one domestic airline in the country
The airline industry, which is the phrase
Every airline magazine in the house
An airline, he told me in 1996

answers.why: airline 意为“航空公司”，1966 年表哥进了一家航空公司，在我们家这就等于离开了。
airline ticket 意为“机票”，祖母把他 1968 年寄来的机票在抽屉里保存了三十一年。
an airline pilot 意为“航空公司飞行员”，到 1971 年他成了航空公司的飞行员。
airline 意为“航线、航路”，他最早飞的那条航线有九百英里，飞四小时。
domestic airline 意为“国内航空公司”，那时全国只有一家国内航空公司。
airline industry 意为“航空业”，1979 年他用了这个说法，那时已有四家公司、九种机票。
airlines 意为“各家航空公司、航空业”，1984 年各家航空公司在同一年全部亏损。
airline 作定语，意为“航空公司的”，屋里每一本航空公司杂志都印着同样的四张照片。
airline 意为“航空公司”，我要点名的是那家给一个从未飞过的女人寄了机票、却从不回信的公司。
airline 意为“航线”，他说航线不过是两个人之间的距离，以及缩短它的价钱。
